query:
SELECT library_files.library_id AS "library!", local_images.role,
                              local_images.stored, library_items.season, (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS "ids?: String"
                       FROM local_images
                       JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = local_images.version_id
                       JOIN library_items ON library_items.file_id = local_images.version_id
                       JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = library_items.id
                       WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched'
                       ORDER BY library_items.added_at, library_items.id
